Package org.aeonbits.owner.validation

Class ConfigValidationException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
org.aeonbits.owner.validation.ConfigValidationException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ConfigValidationException extends RuntimeException
Thrown when a configuration is created and its values do not satisfy the constraints its methods declare.

It names every violation, for the same reason MissingMandatoryPropertyException names every missing key: a configuration is read once, at startup, and a reader who is told one thing wrong at a time restarts once per mistake.

Since:
2.0.0
Author:
Matteo Baccan

    • getKeys

      public List<String> getKeys()
      Lists the keys of the properties that failed a constraint, which is what a caller most often wants: the same key it would have read the value with. A key appears once per violation, so a property failing two constraints appears twice.
      Returns:
      an unmodifiable list of the keys.
